name: Breadwinners
description: Two ducks fly around in a rocket-powered van, delivering bread to other ducks in Pondgea.

videos.title: Thug Loaf
videos.overview: When SwaySway and Buhdeuce deliver bread to the bad part of Duck Town, things go from quazy to quazier.

videos.title: Mine All Mine
videos.overview: SwaySway and Buhdeuce meet the most righteous dude in the planet: the Bread Maker!

videos.title: Stank Breath
videos.overview: Buhdeuce has to deal with some awesomely bad stank breath that leads to some awesomely bad trouble.

videos.title: Frog Day Afternoon
videos.overview: SwaySway and Buhdeuce teach their pet Jelly how to fetch, and she accidentally fetches a monster egg.

videos.title: Employee of the Month
videos.overview: Buhdeuce's life is about to change forever when SwaySway gives out an award.

videos.title: Brocrastination
videos.overview: SwaySway and Buhdeuce have to take care of a pile of dirty dishes, before IT takes care of THEM!

videos.title: Rocket Trouble
videos.overview: Buckle up, duckies! The rocket van is about to get some sweet mods from ace-mechanic Ketta.

videos.title: The Brave and the Mold
videos.overview: Mold strikes the bread mines, and the only ones who can strike back are TRUE Breadwinners.

videos.title: Lost at Pond
videos.overview: When the guys get stranded in the middle of the Great Pond, they're forced to level up into "Survivor Ducks."

videos.title: From Bad to Nurse
videos.overview: SwaySway and Buhdeuce show off their "bread-side" manner by nursing their number one customer back to health.

videos.title: Love Loaf
videos.overview: SwaySway and Buhdeuce sneak into a "girls only" summer camp in order to find the one and only Jenny Quackles.

videos.title: Beach Day of Horror
videos.overview: The guys head to the beach and nothing is gonna ruin their day, not even a big scary M-M-M-M-MONSTER!

videos.title: Quazy for Vanessa
videos.overview: SwaySway and Buhdeuce disguise the rocket van as a girl to keep Oonski from stealing it, but their planbackfires when Oonski falls head-over-wheels in love.

videos.title: Tunnel of Fear
videos.overview: The ducks are forced to enter into a scary part of the bread mines.

videos.title: Driver's Breaducation
videos.overview: After wracking up a ton of tickets from Chief Rambamboo, SwaySway and Buhdeuce get sent to traffic school.

videos.title: Food Fight Club
videos.overview: SwaySway and Buhdeuce discover an underground Food Fight Club, and they're gonna have to food fight to save their beaks!

videos.title: Diner Ducks
videos.overview: After wracking up a huge bill at Pumpers, SwaySway and Buhdeuce level up into Diner Ducks to pay off their debt.

videos.title: Switcheroo
videos.overview: Things get awkward when the guys eat a loaf of Switcheroo Bread and swap bodies.

videos.title: Introducktions
videos.overview: SwaySway and Buhdeuce head deep into the bread mines to introduce their number one customer to the Bread Maker!

videos.title: Fowl Feud
videos.overview: After breaking each other's favorite possessions, they get into a feud and might just part ways FOREVER!

videos.title: Insane in the Crane Game
videos.overview: SwaySway and Buhdeuce become obsessed with winning a toy out of the new crane game.

videos.title: Buhdeuce Goes Berserks
videos.overview: When Buhdeuce gets a bad haircut, he goes berserks, and now SwaySway has to calm his buddy down before he gets busted by Rambamboo.

videos.title: Lil' Loafie
videos.overview: When T-Midi rejects a loaf of defective bread, SwaySway and Buhdeuce take the loaf under their wing and it becomes super famous.

videos.title: Oonski the Grateful
videos.overview: When the ducks accidentally save Oonski from a monster, he owes them a debt of gratitude.

videos.title: TNT-Midi
videos.overview: SwaySway and Buhdeuce accidentally deliver Spicy Dynamite Bread to T-Midi, and now they have to fix up their mix up.

videos.title: Poltergoose
videos.overview: The rocket van gets possessed by a Poltergoose, who turns out to be a real pain in the beak.

videos.title: Night of the Living Bread
videos.overview: SwaySway and Buhdeuce invent a loaf of bread so irresistible, it turns their customers into bread-craving zombies.

videos.title: Pizzawinners
videos.overview: SwaySway and Buhdeuce meet their match when two punker cranes start delivering pizza on their turf.

videos.title: Yeasterday
videos.overview: Buhdeuce has a bad day, so he eats Yeasterday Bread, reliving the same day over and over with bad results for SwaySway.

videos.title: Space Ducks
videos.overview: Strap on your helmets and hold on to your tail feathers because SwaySway and Buhdeuce are delivering bread in space!

videos.title: Kettastrophe
videos.overview: When Ketta crashes at the Swamp Pad, her home modifications drive the guys whoa-ma-gosh quazy.

videos.title: Pondgea's Got Talent
videos.overview: When Pumpers holds a talent show, SwaySway must overcome his stage fright to perform a love song for Jenny Quackles.

videos.title: Raging Mole
videos.overview: SwaySway and Buhdeuce convince the Bread Maker to lose a wrestling match to Lava Mole.

videos.title: Robot Arms
videos.overview: Buhdeuce gets robot arms to help him mine bread, but he ends up having to use them to help everyone else out instead.

videos.title: PB & J
videos.overview: The guys adopt a Ponda Bear, who seems like a cute, sweet pet... but he's actually quite the opposite.

videos.title: Big Screen Buhdeuce
videos.overview: Buhdeuce is lured away from Breadwinning by the glitz and glamour of being a movie star.

videos.title: Weekend at Furfle's
videos.overview: When Mrs. Furfle falls into a deep magical sleep, SwaySway and Buhdeuce pretend she's awake so she won't miss her big date with T-Midi.

videos.title: Birds of a Feather
videos.overview: When SwaySway and Buhdeuce are trapped in a cave of stale bread by a ferocious Tunnel Eater, the guys pass the time by reminiscing about how they first met and became best baps for life.

videos.title: Adventures in Big Baby Bun Sitting
videos.overview: SwaySway and Buhdeuce babysit Big Baby Buns, but a sudden growth spurt makes the task even more challenging.

videos.title: Crumbskull
videos.overview: The guys accidentally feed Ketta Dunce Bread just when her smartness is needed to save the planet.

videos.title: Chest Hair Club
videos.overview: When SwaySway grows a clump of chest hair, Buhdeuce fears his best bap will outgrow him, so he makes a dangerous wish for his own chest hair.

videos.title: Bros' Night Out
videos.overview: SwaySway and Buhdeuce take T-Midi on a "bro's night out" and he goes quazy!

videos.title: Bad to the Duck Bone
videos.overview: When SwaySway discovers Jenny Quackles only likes bad boys, he eats Dark Rye and turns evil, much to Buhdeuce's unhappy-quackiness.

videos.title: Rodeo Ducks
videos.overview: SwaySway and Buhdeuce go to the rodeo to fulfill their dream of becoming rodeo stars.

videos.title: Viking Ducks
videos.overview: The guys accidentally get hired by Oonski to be his new crewmates, but they have trouble with their on-the-job training.

videos.title: Birthday Bread
videos.overview: Buhdeuce eats a bread that makes every day his birthday.

videos.title: Wolf Head Bread
videos.overview: SwaySway and Buhdeuce want to impress T-Midi by delivering him the rarest bread in all the Bread Mines: Wolf Head Bread.

videos.title: Rock N' Roar
videos.overview: SwaySway and Buhdeuce help their rock idol get his career back on track.

videos.title: Movie Ducks
videos.overview: Steven Quackberg wants to make a movie about the Breadwinners. Unfortunately, he doesn't want to make it with the Breadwinners.

videos.title: Don't Feed the Duckosaurs
videos.overview: Buhdeuce and SwaySway get lost in duckosaur country where they're stalked by a vicious D-Rex.

videos.title: Wrath of the Pizza Lord
videos.overview: The mean-spirited Pizzawinners have an even more mean-spirited boss- so the guys set out to help them.

videos.title: Shrunken Ducks
videos.overview: SwaySway and Buhdeuce eat Shrink Bread to hide from Rambamboo, and now must scale her hairy body.

videos.title: Trash Bandit
videos.overview: SwaySway and Buhdeuce get trapped inside the Swamp Pad by an ultra-belligerent Raccoon, who has an insatiable lust for their trash.

videos.title: Eat at Pumpers
videos.overview: SwaySway and Buhdeuce help Pumpers promote the diner by making a commercial jingle.

videos.title: A Crustmas Story
videos.overview: SwaySway and Buhdeuce stay up all night waiting for Santa Crust to come - while reading each other quazy holiday stories and singing Crustmas Carols.

videos.title: Flock Collecting
videos.overview: SwaySway and Buhdeuce get into the hobby of rock collecting, only to discover that they are the ones being collected!

videos.title: Bye Bye Booty
videos.overview: Buhdeuce attempts to get his butt back after it detaches itself because of overuse.

videos.title: Bread Foot
videos.overview: SwaySway gets mistaken for the legendary Bread Foot.

videos.title: My Fair Frog
videos.overview: When T-Midi insults Jelly, the guys enter her in the exclusive Duck Town Frog Show to prove that she's the best frog in the entire world.

videos.title: Roboloafie
videos.overview: When SwaySway and Buhdeuce accidentally cause Lil Loafie to get smashed, Ketta rebuilds him into a law enforcement machine!

videos.title: Bad Zituation
videos.overview: When SwaySway gets a zit that he thinks makes him look hideous, he runs away to Monster Island.

videos.title: Sneeze The Day
videos.overview: Buhdeuce gets a cold... and then gives it to the Bread Maker, which causes his magic to go haywire.

videos.title: Tooth Fairy Ducks
videos.overview: After accidentally taking the Tooth Fairy out of action, SwaySway and Buhdeuce have to level up into Tooth Fairy Ducks.

videos.title: Slumber Party of Horror
videos.overview: T-Midi insists that the Breadwinners stay over for a slumber party. But when they tell scary stories, they accidentally summon One-Eyed Peekaboo.

videos.title: Quack to the Future
videos.overview: SwaySway finally builds up the courage to ask Jenny Quackles out on a date.

videos.title: Graining Day
videos.overview: While SwaySway is training Buhdeuce how to survive monster attacks, they stumble upon a mysterious old Breadwinner in the bread mines.

videos.title: Breadator
videos.overview: In the bread mines, the guys stumble across a creature that hunts Breadwinners for sport.

videos.title: Buhdouble Trouble
videos.overview: SwaySway likes his bap so much he wishes there were more of him. So Buhdeuce eats Clone Bread, creating not quite exact copies of himself.

videos.title: Unlucky Duckies
videos.overview: SwaySway discovers a loaf of Pot of Gold Bread and gets cursed by a surly Loafrechaun.

videos.title: Substitute Breadwinner
videos.overview: When SwaySway suffers a major butt injury, Ketta takes over as a substitute Breadwinner.

videos.title: Taloney Baloney
videos.overview: When SwaySway and Buhdeuce discover that T-Midi was a child star, it has unforeseen consequences with Oonski.

videos.title: Rambamwho?
videos.overview: Rambamboo eats a loaf of Forget Who I Am Bread and forgets who she is.

videos.title: Nightmare on Swamp Pad Lane
videos.overview: In order to stop Buhdeuce's recurring nightmare, SwaySway eats a loaf of bread that enables him to enter into Buhdeuce's dream world.

videos.title: The Princess Frog Bride
videos.overview: When Jelly gets mistaken for a princess, the guys have to rescue her from Oonski The Great!

videos.title: Super Duck vs. Muscle Bread
videos.overview: SwaySway and Buhdeuce L-L-L-L-Level up! into Superhero Ducks to figure out which of their favorite comic book heroes is more powerful.

videos.title: Great White Shark Bread
videos.overview: SwaySway and Buhdeuce take to the Great Pond when an old sea captain's order turns into an epic quest.

videos.title: Freaky Finger Bread
videos.overview: When Buhdeuce gives SwaySway a loaf of Freaky Finger Bread for his birthday, SwaySway is forced to pretend he likes it!
